replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
I'm sorry to say but your map has been denied from the Avicus Network.

Here are the reasons why:

Uneven Island Spacing (Islands need to be equal)
There is also too much void. Consider adding more middle islands/between spawn and middle islands to reduce the chance of dying so easily while bridging

You may resubmit your map once edited
